LanguageData.CC_Settings_Journeys_Tip: From the Decrees page, the World page or a place on the region map, plan a journey: who goes (colonists, and the animals to bring), where (a town, a place, or nowhere in particular for a length you choose) and when (an hour on a day, the next dawn by default). The planner works out what to take from the stores for the days on the road (food with a margin, travel food first; medicine; bedrolls and any mod's tents for nights out; feed for animals where they can't graze) and you can change the list. A day before, each traveller's night is shifted so they wake rested in time and their recreation is topped up; in the last hours they put work aside, change into clothes for the weather on the way, pick up their share, have a meal, wash (with Dubs Bad Hygiene) and gather at the gate. At the hour, if everyone is ready, the game's own caravan forming takes exactly them and the rest of the goods and they leave together; if someone isn't, a letter asks what to do.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_Journeys: Plan who goes where and when: they get ready together and set off at the hour.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_JourneySleep_Tip: A day before a journey, each traveller's timetable for the night before is moved (to bed earlier or later) so they wake rested a few hours before setting off, without staying up so long they run themselves down. Their own hours come back when they set off. Off: they keep their own nights; recreation is still topped up before the night and the last hours are still free.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_JourneySleep: Travellers go to bed early or late so they wake rested in time.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_JourneyClothes_Tip: The planner reads the weather along the way and at the destination over the days of the trip, and a traveller who wouldn't be comfortable through it changes into clothes from the stores that bring them closer (a parka and a tuque for a winter road, a duster for a hot one), nobody's piece given twice. They keep those on until they set off. Armour, locked pieces and pieces you made them wear stay on.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_JourneyClothes: Travellers change into clothes from the stores for the weather on the way.
